segments.title: Phone number in the profile schema
context: A profile had a name and an email address, and no phone number. The account form now has a phone field. The form saves a profile only when the phone is an optional plus sign and then 7 to 15 digits or spaces. A shopper whose stored profile has no phone cannot save a new name or email address until they type one.
## Overview
- **When** a shopper opens /account, **then** [the form shows a Phone input under the Email input](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L24).
- **When** a shopper saves with the phone `555 0100`, **then** [the request that saves the profile carries the phone](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L14-16).

- **When** a shopper saves with the Phone input empty or with `555-0100`, **then** the form sends no request and [shows an error under the Phone input](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L25).

- **When** the stored profile has no phone and a shopper saves a new name, **then** the form sends no request, because [the schema requires a phone](code:src/routes/account/components/profile-schema.ts#L9).
- **When** a shopper opens the catalogue or the cart, **then** nothing changes.
## Implementation
**`src/routes/account/components/profile-schema.ts`**

- Added [`PHONE_PATTERN`](code:src/routes/account/components/profile-schema.ts#PHONE_PATTERN), a regular expression that matches an optional `+` and then 7 to 15 characters that are each a digit or a space.
- Modified [`profileSchema`](code:src/routes/account/components/profile-schema.ts#profileSchema) to require a `phone` string that matches `PHONE_PATTERN`.
**`src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx`**
- Added [an `<Input>` with the label `Phone`, registered as `phone`](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L24), to `<ProfileForm />`.
- Added [a paragraph that shows `formState.errors.phone.message`](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L25) under that input.

blockLabels.label: Matches an optional + and 7 to 15 digits or spaces

nodes.impactReason: `updateProfile()` in `src/api/profile.ts` sends `JSON.stringify(profile)`, so the body of `PUT /profile` now has a `phone`. `fetchProfile()` does not parse the response with `profileSchema`, so a stored profile with no phone reaches the form with `phone` as `undefined`.

waypoints.title: Added the pattern that a phone must match
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `PHONE_PATTERN`, a regular expression that matches an optional `+` and then 7 to 15 characters that are each a digit or a space. [`profileSchema` passes the constant to `.regex()` for its `phone` property](code:src/routes/account/components/profile-schema.ts#L9), so that [`<ProfileForm />` shows an error](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L25) for a phone such as `555-0100`.

waypoints.title: Modified the profile schema to require a phone
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a schema `profileSchema` that:

- now has a `phone` property, a string that must match [`PHONE_PATTERN`](code:src/routes/account/components/profile-schema.ts#PHONE_PATTERN)
- gives [the inferred type `Profile`](code:src/routes/account/components/profile-schema.ts#L12) a `phone: string`

[`<ProfileForm />` passes the schema to `zodResolver()`](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L10), so that the form does not call [`onSubmit()`](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L14-16) for a profile whose phone is `""`, `undefined` or `555-0100`. `fetchProfile()` and `updateProfile()` in `src/api/profile.ts` use `Profile`, so the body of `PUT /profile` now has a `phone`.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the rule the pull request exists for: `profileSchema` now returns an error for a profile with no phone that matches [`PHONE_PATTERN`](code:src/routes/account/components/profile-schema.ts#PHONE_PATTERN). The other waypoints add the pattern and [the input a shopper types the phone in](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L24).

waypoints.title: Added a Phone input to the profile form
waypoints.reading:
The author added an input and a paragraph to a component `<ProfileForm />` that:

- registers the input as `phone`, with the label `Phone`
- shows `formState.errors.phone.message` under the input when the `phone` field has an error

[`profileSchema` now requires a `phone`](code:src/routes/account/components/profile-schema.ts#L9), so that without this input no shopper can type one and no submit reaches `onSubmit()`. The input starts with `profile.phone`, because `defaultValues` is `profile`.
